company_name: GTEN BALL SCREW TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — GTEN BALL SCREW provides high-precision motion control components used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
summary: GTEN BALL SCREW TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD. specializes in the design and manufacture of high-precision ball screws, which are critical components in semiconductor manufacturing equipment. With a focus on quality and innovation, GTEN exports a significant portion of its products to Europe and North America, leveraging its competitive pricing due to lower production costs in Taiwan.
capabilities: High-precision ball screws with JIS grades C3 to C5
Integrated production facility for precision components
Competitive pricing strategy due to cost-effective manufacturing

regional_presence.Taiwan: GTEN operates a fully integrated production facility covering over 11,000 square meters.
regional_presence.Europe: Exports over 70% of its output to Europe.
regional_presence.North America: Exports over 70% of its output to North America.
